objects.title: WELCOME, CLIMBER
objects.text:
This is the Tutorial Floor of the Tower of [Trials].
Walk up to signs and press E (or tap USE) to read them.
Move: WASD / left stick.   Aim: mouse / right stick.

objects.title: THE TOWER
objects.text:
The Tower has 11 Floors: this Tutorial Floor and 10 Main Floors.
Each floor is a story act made of dungeons.
Finish the Trial of Bones, then climb to Floor 1.

objects.title: COMBAT BASICS
objects.text:
ATTACK: left click / hold the right stick.
DODGE: SPACE (costs 25% stamina, 1.5s cooldown).
Stamina refills 15%/s out of combat, 5%/s in combat.
Crits: 15% chance for 125% damage at level 1.

objects.title: SWORD AURA
objects.text:
Melee users can unleash BERSERK (key R).
It burns 2.5% Physical Force per second.
Physical Force is split into 4 Aura Cores (25% each).
Empty = Life Force Decay.   Ending early = Exhaustion.

objects.title: FOCUS SYSTEM (RANGER)
objects.text:
Hold attack with a Bow, Crossbow or Pistol to FOCUS.
All targets in view are highlighted; one gets locked on.
Focus fills in 2.5s at 100% Focus Speed. Damage scales with focus.
100-150% focus costs no extra stamina; above 150% every 10% costs 5% stamina.

objects.title: SWITCHING WEAPONS
objects.text:
Press Q (or tap SWAP) to cycle weapons.
Open the menu (TAB / MENU) to see every weapon and its sheet stats.

objects.title: TRAITS AND SKILLS
objects.text:
You carry ONE trait (a passive), dealt by rank each run.
Skills are separate: press F to open the skill wheel.
Trait rank does not change your Level rank.

objects.title: MAGIC SYSTEM
objects.text:
Magic and Mana need an Innate Talent: a Magic-type trait.
At the Mana Altar your talent may form 1 or 2 Mana Circles.
No Mana Circle = no Mana = no Book or Staff.

objects.title: THE GATE
objects.text:
Clear the Trial of Bones to unlock the stairs to Floor 1.
Rank of a dungeon decides how strong its enemies are.
Level ranks: F 1-10, E 11-30, D 31-49, C 50-79, B 80-99, A 100-150, S 151+.
